File is human-curated. New entries land via a methodology-author workflow
that is OUT OF SCOPE for this pipeline. The runtime treats the CSV as the
source of truth for who is tracked.

compiler_notes: The Relative Ranking score (1–10, from a stakeholder survey per §4.9) is NOT carried here — it lives in a separate stage (relative_ranking_survey, not built in this MVP). Methodology blends the two in the relationship- graph stage downstream.
Curation methodology (how researchers add/remove associations) is itself methodology-author work outside this DAG.
